findings.problem: The grind step came third, after the pull, so the steps did not make the drink in order. The pull step also never locked the portafilter in.
findings.change: Reordered: grind as for espresso, or a step finer for the full 25 to 30 seconds; dose and tamp; "Lock in, pull onto a scale and stop at 18 to 30 g"; taste.

findings.problem: "The first, sweetest part" is a superlative said to a guest. It is also loose: by the extraction lesson acids come out first and sweetness after them.
findings.change: Now reads "the first part of an espresso, cut short: thicker, sweeter, less bitter, two sips".
